name: tracetoon
description: Creates your PR with a description written from your Codex session logs, and an optional one-off comic. Every claim is checked against what your agent actually did before the PR is posted. On 61 real pull requests from 12 repositories, AI judges who agreed on a winner preferred the descriptions from Tracetoon's evidence graph to its earlier multi-agent workflow 83 to 34 on Codex, at 46% lower cost per PR.

interface.longDescription: Creates your PR with a description written from your Codex session logs, and an optional one-off comic. Every claim is checked against what your agent actually did before the PR is posted. On 61 real pull requests from 12 repositories, AI judges who agreed on a winner preferred the descriptions from Tracetoon's evidence graph to its earlier multi-agent workflow 83 to 34 on Codex, at 46% lower cost per PR. It creates or updates the PR with the GitHub CLI; needs git and gh signed in. Comic images go to an image service only after you approve one.
